work_unit: Privacy-safe opt-in Langfuse source-grounding evaluation foundation

assessment.risk_reason: The external experiment path must never export private licence content, Q&A content, identifiers, or secrets.

actual_dispatch.worker_scope: Standalone synthetic evaluation script, focused offline tests, and owned evaluation/routing documentation.

implementation.local_behavior: Seven fixed synthetic status/citation envelopes are classified and exactly scored without importing Langfuse or making network calls.
implementation.export_gate: Export requires --export-langfuse, LICENCEIQ_LANGFUSE_EVAL_EXPORT=true, complete LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY/LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY/LANGFUSE_BASE_URL, and a valid HTTP(S) server URL.
implementation.export_payload: Fixed fixture labels, allowlisted status labels, integer citation counts, expected category labels, and fixed suite metadata only.
implementation.sdk_path: Langfuse Python SDK 4.15.4 local-data run_experiment with a deterministic item evaluator and max_concurrency=1.
implementation.runtime_integration: No runtime application file was changed. The evaluator is separate from the privacy-safe licenceiq.question span and its nested provider observations.

attempts.outcome: Initial implementation completed; focused verification found one over-broad test assertion and strict protocol typing errors.
Narrowed the privacy assertion to forbidden fields and explicitly adapted the installed SDK client/evaluation types; focused checks passed.

verification.network: No live Langfuse call was attempted and no credentials were used.
verification.offline_command: passed with seven of seven cases and zero failures
verification.disabled_export_probe: stopped before SDK use because the dedicated opt-in was absent

limitations: This foundation scores only the status/citation-count envelope; it does not establish answer correctness, citation support, retrieval quality, OCR quality, or production accuracy.
A live Langfuse experiment remains unverified until an operator explicitly enables export with valid credentials.
The separate fictional golden-dataset proposal remains subject to its own approval and is not created or uploaded by this work unit.
